description: Source code for the PinRepository class managing hardware pin usage and port mapping in an embedded system firmware.

classes.name: PinRepository
classes.description: Class responsible for managing hardware pin usage and ensuring no conflicts occur.

methods.name: getPortIndex
methods.description: Returns index of a given port based on its ioportid_t identifier.

methods.name: reportPins
methods.description: Reports all used pins and total count via logger.

methods.name: parseBrainPin
methods.description: Parses string representation of a physical pin into brain_pin_e enum.

methods.name: hwPortname
methods.description: Returns string name of hardware port for a given brain_pin_e.

methods.name: initPinRepository
methods.description: Initializes the pin repository, setting up data structures and console actions.

methods.name: getIndex
methods.description: Calculates index in PIN_USED array based on port and pin.

methods.name: markUsed
methods.description: Marks a pin as used with a message, returns true if already used.

methods.name: getPinFunction
methods.description: Retrieves the function or purpose assigned to a specific brain input pin.

methods.name: unmarkPin
methods.description: Unmarks a pin as used, freeing it for future use.
